defmodule CryptoNative do
  @moduledoc """
  NIF-based cryptographic operations with async task support.
  Uses a native C library via NIF for performance-critical operations.
  """

  @on_load :load_nif
  @nif_path "priv/crypto_native"

  def load_nif do
    :erlang.load_nif(String.to_charlist(@nif_path), 0)
  end

  # NIF stubs - replaced at load time
  def nif_derive_key(_password, _salt, _iterations), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def nif_encrypt(_plaintext, _key, _iv), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def nif_decrypt(_ciphertext, _key, _iv), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def nif_hmac(_data, _key), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def nif_secure_compare(_a, _b), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
end

defmodule CryptoService do
  @moduledoc """
  High-level cryptographic service providing authenticated encryption
  with async task-based parallelism for batch operations.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @derive_iterations 100_000
  @iv_bytes 16
  @key_bytes 32

  defstruct [:key_cache, :pending_ops, :nonce_counter]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      key_cache: %{},
      pending_ops: %{},
      nonce_counter: :atomics.new(1, signed: false)
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @doc "Derive a key from password, caching the result"
  def derive_key(password, salt) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:derive_key, password, salt})
  end

  @doc "Encrypt multiple plaintexts concurrently using derived key"
  def encrypt_batch(plaintexts, password, salt) when is_list(plaintexts) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:encrypt_batch, plaintexts, password, salt}, 30_000)
  end

  @doc "Verify and decrypt with authentication tag checking"
  def authenticated_decrypt(ciphertext_with_tag, password, salt) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:auth_decrypt, ciphertext_with_tag, password, salt})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:derive_key, password, salt}, _from, state) do
    cache_key = :crypto.hash(:sha256, password <> salt)
    
    case Map.get(state.key_cache, cache_key) do
      nil ->
        derived = CryptoNative.nif_derive_key(password, salt, @derive_iterations)
        new_cache = Map.put(state.key_cache, cache_key, derived)
        {:reply, {:ok, derived}, %{state | key_cache: new_cache}}
      cached ->
        {:reply, {:ok, cached}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:encrypt_batch, plaintexts, password, salt}, _from, state) do
    {key, new_state} = ensure_key(password, salt, state)
    
    # Launch concurrent encryption tasks
    tasks = Enum.map(plaintexts, fn plaintext ->
      Task.async(fn ->
        iv = generate_iv(state.nonce_counter)
        ciphertext = CryptoNative.nif_encrypt(plaintext, key, iv)
        tag = compute_auth_tag(ciphertext, key, iv)
        {iv, ciphertext, tag}
      end)
    end)

    results = Task.await_many(tasks, 10_000)
    {:reply, {:ok, results}, new_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:auth_decrypt, {iv, ciphertext, tag}, password, salt}, _from, state) do
    {key, new_state} = ensure_key(password, salt, state)
    
    # Verify authentication tag before decryption
    expected_tag = compute_auth_tag(ciphertext, key, iv)
    
    if verify_tag(tag, expected_tag) do
      plaintext = CryptoNative.nif_decrypt(ciphertext, key, iv)
      {:reply, {:ok, plaintext}, new_state}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :authentication_failed}, new_state}
    end
  end

  # --- Private helpers ---

  defp ensure_key(password, salt, state) do
    cache_key = :crypto.hash(:sha256, password <> salt)
    
    case Map.get(state.key_cache, cache_key) do
      nil ->
        derived = CryptoNative.nif_derive_key(password, salt, @derive_iterations)
        new_cache = Map.put(state.key_cache, cache_key, derived)
        {derived, %{state | key_cache: new_cache}}
      cached ->
        {cached, state}
    end
  end

  defp generate_iv(nonce_counter) do
    # Increment atomic counter for uniqueness
    count = :atomics.add_get(nonce_counter, 1, 1)
    # Combine counter with timestamp for IV generation
    timestamp = System.system_time(:nanosecond)
    base = <<count::unsigned-64, timestamp::unsigned-64>>
    # Truncate SHA-256 to IV size
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, base)
    |> binary_part(0, @iv_bytes)
  end

  defp compute_auth_tag(ciphertext, key, iv) do
    # HMAC over IV || ciphertext for authenticated encryption
    CryptoNative.nif_hmac(iv <> ciphertext, key)
  end

  defp verify_tag(provided_tag, expected_tag) do
    # Use constant-time comparison from NIF to prevent timing attacks
    byte_size(provided_tag) == byte_size(expected_tag) and
      do_compare(provided_tag, expected_tag)
  end

  defp do_compare(a, b) do
    # The NIF secure_compare returns 0 for equal, nonzero for different
    # We pass the raw binaries to the NIF for constant-time comparison
    result = CryptoNative.nif_secure_compare(a, b)
    result == 0
  end
end

defmodule CryptoService.BatchProcessor do
  @moduledoc """
  Processes large encryption workloads by splitting across
  multiple async tasks with shared key material.
  """

  @chunk_size 64

  def process_stream(stream, password, salt) do
    stream
    |> Stream.chunk_every(@chunk_size)
    |> Stream.map(fn chunk ->
      {:ok, results} = CryptoService.encrypt_batch(chunk, password, salt)
      results
    end)
    |> Enum.to_list()
    |> List.flatten()
  end

  def decrypt_and_verify(encrypted_items, password, salt) do
    # Process decryptions concurrently
    tasks = Enum.map(encrypted_items, fn item ->
      Task.async(fn ->
        CryptoService.authenticated_decrypt(item, password, salt)
      end)
    end)

    Task.await_many(tasks, 30_000)
  end
end
